summary: @@matthewlang because workplaces are full of old people. On college campus any non Apple device has a touch interface and in K12 every kid chooses touch as voice as the primary input. Old people die or retire. Touch will come to the workplace.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @@matthewlang because workplaces are full of old people. On college campus any non Apple device has a touch interface and in K12 every kid chooses touch as voice as the primary input. Old people die or retire. Touch will come to the workplace.
